from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid[0])
    center = next((c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 2), n // 2)
    out = [[0 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        if r <= center:
            left, right = center - r, center + r
            for c in (left, right):
                if 0 <= c < n:
                    out[r][c] = 2
            lo, hi = max(0, left), min(n - 1, right)
        else:
            lo, hi = 0, n - 1
        for c in range(lo, hi + 1):
            if (c - r) % 4 == 2 and out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p=progdir/'task-a8c91d69.py'
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
